project_name: CYBER HQ: Stop the Mystery Hacker
app_type: 3d_experience / theatrical fullscreen interactive kiosk web app
target_audience: Children ages 7–10 in classroom presentation (projector viewed from back of room)
theme: Dark Command Center (Dark Charcoal background with Neon Electric Purple & Magenta accents)

sizes.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-wider uppercase
sizes.section_header: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-wide uppercase
sizes.status_badge: text-sm sm:text-base font-mono tracking-widest uppercase font-bold

layout_and_grids.fullscreen: h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#0B0C10] select-none text-white relative flex flex-col justify-between p-4 md:p-8
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 md:gap-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full flex-1 items-stretch py-4
layout_and_grids.kiosk_scaling: Designed for 1920x1080 responsive scaling with minimum 24px/32px touch & click targets for high visibility from the back of the classroom.

image_urls.usage_note: Use this cute 3D cartoon character image for the Mystery Hacker in typing overlays, mission dialogs, and hacker reaction panels.

sound_effects_engine.type: Web Audio API synth generator (In-browser, zero external mp3 dependencies)
sounds: alarm: dual-tone oscillating square wave warning chime
lock_close: low thud heavy bass drop + metallic click

key_features_and_states.fullscreen_launcher: Initial overlay 'ENTER CYBER HQ' button that requests Browser Fullscreen API and unlocks Web Audio context.
key_features_and_states.state_secure: Header: CYBER HQ, Subheading: CYBER DEFENSE SYSTEM. Status: SECURE (Green glow badge). THREATS DETECTED: 0. 3 modules (IDENTITY, SECRETS, INTEGRITY) locked and operational.
key_features_and_states.presenter_trigger: Press 'H' or click hidden presenter action to start Hacker Intrusion sequence.

intrusion_sequence.effects: Visual flicker/glitch CSS animation, red alarm strobe overlay, alarm sound effect.
typing_messages: HA! YOU THINK YOUR SYSTEM IS SAFE?
MYSTERY HACKER HAS TAKEN OVER CYBER HQ!
I HAVE LOCKED YOUR 3 SECURITY MODULES!
CAN YOUR CLASSROOM CADETS SOLVE ALL 3 MISSIONS TO STOP ME?
intrusion_sequence.lock_animation: Locks slam shut sequentially with heavy sound, THREATS DETECTED counter changes to 3, STATUS becomes CRITICAL BREACH.
intrusion_sequence.cta: Prominent glowing button 'BEGIN CYBER MISSION' appears.

mission_1_identity.title: MISSION 1: IDENTITY DEFENSE (Who To Trust)
mission_1_identity.mechanic: Examine incoming messages/emails/badges. Kids identify fake messages (e.g., 'Free V-Bucks! Click here!', 'Captain Byte needs your password!') vs real official alerts. Must complete 3 verification challenges to unlock IDENTITY module.

mission_2_secrets.title: MISSION 2: SECRETS VAULT (Crack the Secret Code)
mission_2_secrets.mechanic: Decode a Caesar/Symbol cipher or construct a super password using length, uppercase, number, and special cyber-symbol blocks. Features live strength meter and visual cipher decoder ring.

mission_3_integrity.title: MISSION 3: DATA INTEGRITY (Spot What Changed)
mission_3_integrity.mechanic: Two side-by-side cyber grid transmission files. Mystery Hacker scrambled 3 data blocks (tampered values/corrupted code pixels). Kids tap the corrupted nodes to restore original data checksum.

key_features_and_states.victory_sequence: When all 3 modules are unlocked, trigger system purge animation, fireworks/laser burst particle canvas, system returns to SYSTEM SECURE, threats count to 0, and displays a printable/awardable 'CYBER DEFENDER CERTIFICATE' for the class.
key_features_and_states.presenter_help_modal: Triggered by pressing '?' or 'Shift+H' or clicking 'Presenter Controls' button in top corner. Displays shortcut reference: H = Trigger Intrusion, 1 = Jump to Mission 1, 2 = Jump to Mission 2, 3 = Jump to Mission 3, R = Reset HQ, F = Toggle Fullscreen, Sound mute toggle.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all code files are Javascript (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Import Orbitron, Outfit, and JetBrains Mono fonts in index.css.

Include data-testid attributes on ALL interactive buttons, mission cards, choices, and navigation triggers (e.g. data-testid='enter-fullscreen-btn', data-testid='trigger-intrusion-btn', data-testid='mission-1-card', data-testid='choice-phishing-fake').
Use Framer Motion for lock animations, glitch text, mission modal transitions, and victory particles.
Maintain strict dark theme (#0B0C10) with electric purple (#A855F7), cyan (#00F0FF), and magenta (#E024A5) glows. Never use plain white or boring corporate colors.
Ensure all text is large and ultra-readable from a distance on classroom projectors.
Prevent page scrollbars (`overflow-hidden` on body/root) and default touch gestures.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently with crisp glowing neon borders. DO NOT use muddy background gradients.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, pulse glows, sound effects, and entrance transitions.
Use 2-3x generous spacing with internal container padding to prevent layout crowding.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons; use Lucide-react icons like Shield, Lock, Unlock, AlertTriangle, Key, Eye, CheckCircle2, Terminal, Cpu.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
